question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

The most notorious serial killer of the 19th century remains known only by the psudonym of Jack the Ripper.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"psudonym"** is incorrectly spelt and should be "pseudonym". "Pseudonym" means a fictitious name, especially one used by an author. (छद्मनाम)

**Example: **The famous author used a** pseudonym** to keep her real identity a secret.

 
• **"Pseudonym" **is the correct spelling of the word. (छद्मनाम)

 
 
• **Example: **Many writers use a **pseudonym** to publish their works.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Century **(सदी): A period of one hundred years.

 
 
• **Example:** The 20th century saw many technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **Notorious **(कुख्यात): Famous or well-known, typically for some bad quality or deed.
 
 
• **Example: **He became notorious for his involvement in the scandal.
 
 
 
• **Serial** (क्रमिक): Consisting of, forming part of, or taking place in a series.
 
 
• **Example:** The serial publication of the novel kept readers eagerly awaiting each new installment.
